blocks.html: Seeing which, the commissioners resolve to ask, apart and in secret, of the newcomer certain things among the most hidden, on which neither the one nor the other had yet been interrogated, nor on anything that came near them; which was done, and truly (as was since verified) answered by him. Afterwards, having had him withdrawn, they have the prisoner brought in, to whom they put the same interrogations, up to the number of ten or twelve, who answers in everything like the other. Which astonished the company, and made them fall into the opinion that the prisoner had something of magic — as indeed he was ill-famed for it in the said places of Artigat, Le Pin, Sagias and other neighbouring places.
